test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and verify equality
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt and verify output
test_gtn_save_load: test saving and loading a gtn graph using gtn.save and gtn.load and verify equality
